user.title: Add a Local Link timetable
user.description: Enter the published Local Link timetable page and stop name. Select the days this configured timetable operates. For pages with separate timetable columns, enter the exact service column heading (for example Mon–Fri or Mon–Sun & Public Holidays). If the stop appears more than once, add text from the desired direction/section row.

error.invalid_url: Use an HTTPS timetable page hosted on locallinklmf.ie.
error.stop_not_found: No timetable row with departure times matched that stop and direction text.
error.ambiguous_stop: This stop has different times in multiple rows. Enter direction/section text that appears in the desired row.
error.cannot_connect: Could not load the timetable page. Check the URL and try again.
error.service_days: Select at least one day of the week.
error.stop_name_required: Enter the stop name exactly as it appears in the timetable.

abort.already_configured: This timetable page, stop, and direction are already configured.

init.title: Edit Local Link timetable
init.description: Update the published timetable page, stop, direction, service column, or operating days. The integration will validate the changes before saving.
